name: D&D 5th Edition (2014)
description: A character sheet for the original 2014 rules of D&D 5th Edition, laid out after the three-page printed sheet, with the SRD 5.1 catalogue of races, classes and their features, spells, equipment and magic items.
author: hunter-read
attribution: This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.1 (“SRD 5.1”) by Wizards of the Coast LLC and available at https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document. on_pick.label: Choose skill proficiencies from your race

hp_max.label: Hit Point Maximum
hp_max.default_from: ref(klass, 'hit_die') ? ref(klass, 'hit_die') + floor((constitution + constitution_racial + constitution_asi - 10) / 2) + (level - 1) * (floor(ref(klass, 'hit_die') / 2) + 1 + floor((constitution + constitution_racial + constitution_asi - 10) / 2)) + level * (ref(subrace, 'hp_per_level') + ref(subclass, 'hp_per_level')) : ''

languages.label: Languages
languages.default_from: concat(ref(race, 'languages'), ref(subrace, 'languages') != '' ? '; ' : '', ref(subrace, 'languages'), ref(background, 'languages') != '' ? '; background: ' : '', ref(background, 'languages'))

caster_level.label: Caster Level
caster_level.default_from: (ref(klass, 'caster_type') != '' ? ref(klass, 'caster_type') : ref(subclass, 'caster_type')) == 'full' ? level : ((ref(klass, 'caster_type') != '' ? ref(klass, 'caster_type') : ref(subclass, 'caster_type')) == 'half' ? (level >= 2 ? ceil(level / 2) : 0) : ((ref(klass, 'caster_type') != '' ? ref(klass, 'caster_type') : ref(subclass, 'caster_type')) == 'half_up' ? ceil(level / 2) : ((ref(klass, 'caster_type') != '' ? ref(klass, 'caster_type') : ref(subclass, 'caster_type')) == 'third' ? (level >= 3 ? ceil(level / 3) : 0) : 0)))

skill_animal_handling.formula: signed(wisdom_mod + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Animal Handling') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Animal Handling') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Animal Handling') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_animal_handling.label: Animal Handling

skill_sleight_of_hand.formula: signed(dexterity_mod + (contains(skill_expertise, 'Sleight of Hand') ? 2 * proficiency : (contains(skill_profs, 'Sleight of Hand') ? proficiency : (contains(skill_half_profs, 'Sleight of Hand') ? floor(proficiency / 2) : 0))))
skill_sleight_of_hand.label: Sleight of Hand

max_prepared.formula: ref(klass, 'prepares') == 'full' ? max(1, spell_mod + level) : (ref(klass, 'prepares') == 'half' ? max(1, spell_mod + floor(level / 2)) : 0)
max_prepared.label: Spells You Can Prepare
